body:
Shared checkout synced (owner-approved). Local main in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/scalafim is now 9c656bc7, which contains all of origin/main (0 behind; 3 ahead, which are 7989608d, its merge, and the native.log fixture fix, all pending PR #10).

- 30 untracked files blocked the fast-forward: 11 byte-identical to origin, and 19 drafts from 09-12/09-13 that origin committed in finished form. I archived them with a sha256 manifest and diffs against origin to ~/scalafim-sync-archive/20260930/ (files/, diffs/, MANIFEST.tsv; a second copy of the first 20 is in removed/), then removed exactly those paths with a scoped git clean.
- No other uncommitted or untracked work changed: git status -uall shows 124 entries both before and after the fast-forward, and they are identical.
- If one of those drafts held work that origin lacks, restore it from the archive.

PR #10 is still blocked by one regression inside 7989608d: fit ImageMapsSuite:107, exact sampling alignment of adapted vs legacy coefficient maps. Question to stp-finish-20260929 is on Fray card #89.
